facility.name: Brilliant Stars Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation - No Foods That Present Choking Risk: 5 infants and 2 toddlres were fed raisins (dried fruit) for a snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §747.3117(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not have the annual certification form showing they reviewed the Consumer Product Safety recall list and ensured there are no unsafe products at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Use of Safety Straps: An infant was observed in a swing and safety straps were not being used.     CI: During the inspection an assistant caregiver removed the infant from the swing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §747.2307)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three children at the operation do not have updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintain Menus: The operation has not been maintaining menus.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintain Menus (26 TAC §747.3113(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The operations active play space was observed to have a hoe, weeder, and multiple shovels present. The operations backyard fence has multiples gaps measuring larger than 3.5 inches and less than 9 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))

occurrences.finding: Toys and Equipment Sanitized: Children were observed placing toys in their mouth during inspection. Toys were not removed during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Toys and Equipment Sanitized (26 TAC §747.3203(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintain Menus: The operation has not been maintaining menus.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintain Menus (26 TAC §747.3113(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Four children do not have updated feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §747.2321(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not conducted a fire drill since May. The operation has not conducted Lock Down/Shelter and Severe Weather drills, according to standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The operations active play space was observed to have a hoe, weeder, and multiple shovels present. occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO Detection System- One for Each Level of Every Building: The operation does not have a CO detection system for the second level of the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO Detection System- One for Each Level of Every Building (26 TAC §747.5335(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The operations emergency preparedness plan is missing components 1-5.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))
